intro.label: 1 – 4 May · Pula, Sardinia
intro.title:
The greatest procession
in Sardinia
intro.paragrafo1: The procession of Sant'Efisio Martyr is one of the most important and widely attended festivals in Sardinia.
intro.paragrafo2: From the first to the fourth of May, one of the processions that brings together all of Sardinia and its traditions takes place — like very few other occasions.
intro.paragrafo3: It departs from Cagliari on May 1st and arrives on May 2nd in Pula, right outside our Boutique Hotel in the historic centre, facing the Church of San Giovanni. It then continues with a breathtaking procession along Nora beach, in a spectacular setting between the sea and the lagoon.

perche.label: The perfect spot
perche.title: Inside the Festival
perche.paragrafo1: Villa Madau is situated in the heart of the historic centre of Pula, directly on the procession route — facing the Church of San Giovanni.
perche.paragrafo2: Six of our rooms look out directly onto the route. You can wake up to the sound of the launeddas, step out into the street whenever you like, and return when you need rest.
perche.paragrafo3: Breakfast is served in the garden or in the piazzetta, while the village prepares for the festival. You won't be a tourist watching — you'll be part of Pula for four days.

camere.label: View of the procession
camere.title: The six rooms
camere.subtitle: Each one overlooking the route of the Saint. Each with its own story.

01.descrizione: The Bishop's Room, room number one at Villa Madau Hotel in Pula, offers the finest view of the entire route of the Saint. In the heart of the procession, from your private balcony.
01.alt: The Bishop's Room – Villa Madau Pula

02.descrizione: The window overlooking the Church of San Giovanni in the heart of Pula, one of a kind. From Villa Madau Hotel, the Procession has a unique vantage point.
02.alt: The Prior's Room – Villa Madau Pula

03.descrizione: If you're looking for a spacious, romantic room in the heart of the procession, this is it.

04.sottotitolo: The room and the wild olive tree
04.descrizione: The room wrapped by the wild olive tree of the historic centre welcomes the arrival of the procession. From its balcony you can enjoy the unique spectacle of sa Ramadura — the showering of petals onto the Saint.

05.descrizione: Overlooking Via Nora, along which the entire Villa Madau Hotel extends and the main street of Pula, it offers a unique view of the Sant'Efisio Procession.

06.descrizione: Right on the main facade of Villa Madau Hotel, two balconies looking directly onto the square next to the Church of San Giovanni — for a truly unique spectacle.

quando.label: When
quando.testo: From May 1st to 4th every year. The procession arrives in Pula on May 2nd on its way to Nora and returns towards Cagliari on May 4th.

hero.label: Municipality of Pula · Sardinia
hero.title: Gutturu Mannu Park
hero.subtitle:
The largest sclerophyll forest in the Mediterranean,
sanctuary of the Sardinian deer and an oasis of unspoilt nature.
hero.imageAlt: Sardinian deer in Gutturu Mannu Park

introduzione.label: The green lung of southern Sardinia
introduzione.title: An ancient forest at the gates of Pula
introduzione.paragrafo1: The Gutturu Mannu Regional Natural Park — whose name in Campidanese Sardinian means "great gorge" — was established by the Sardinia Region in 2014 and spans the territories of ten municipalities, with Pula serving as the lead municipality, whose mayor chairs the Park Community.
introduzione.paragrafo2: The forest extends over more than 35,000 hectares of continuous woodland, dominated by holm oak, cork oak and wild olive, and is considered the largest sclerophyll forest in the entire Mediterranean basin. Over 600 plant species, 50 of which are endemic, coexist in this extraordinary ecosystem.
introduzione.paragrafo3: The beating heart of the park is the Sardinian deer (Cervus elaphus corsicanus), a subspecies endemic to Sardinia and Corsica that dwindled to fewer than 100 specimens in the 20th century but has since been reborn: the park hosts the world's largest colony of Sardinian deer, with approximately 2,500 specimens roaming freely across the territory.

fotoPaesaggio.citazione: "Nature that doesn't expect to be discovered."

trekking.testo: Over 100 km of CAI-classified trails, for all levels.

cervi.testo: Approximately 2,500 Sardinian deer roam freely in the park. September is the rutting season.

birdwatching.testo: Sardinian goshawk, golden eagle, peregrine falcon and over 100 bird species.

cascate.testo: The Rio Gutturu Mannu creates natural pools and waterfalls reachable on foot.

mountainBike.testo: Dedicated cycling routes through forests and Mediterranean scrubland.

ecomuseo.testo: 55 mapped archaeological sites: nuraghi, giants' tombs, ancient villages.

percorsi.label: Hiking
percorsi.title: Main trails

d212a.descrizione: A trail suitable for all, in the heart of the Is Cannoneris forest. A prime area for spotting the Sardinian deer.

d215.descrizione: From the Pantaleo visitor centre towards the natural spring, through centuries-old holm oaks and Mediterranean scrub.

d204.descrizione: A panoramic route with views over the gorges of the Rio Gutturu Mannu. Option to reach the natural pools.

d200.descrizione: The park's main trail. It partly follows an old charcoal railway through gorges, rivers and holm oak forests.

comeArrivare.label: How to get there
comeArrivare.title: From our hotel to the park

pixinamanna.title: Pula Gateway · Pixinamanna
pixinamanna.paragrafo: The closest access point to Villa Madau, opened in 2024. From Pula, take the SS195 northbound, exit at Polaris/Is Molas and follow the signs to Pixinamanna, home to the Environmental Culture Centre and starting point of the main trails.
pixinamanna.distanza: ~ 15–20 minutes by car from the hotel

pantaleo.title: Main Headquarters · Pantaleo
pantaleo.paragrafo: The park's historic headquarters are in Pantaleo (Santadi), reachable in about 40 minutes. Here you'll find picnic areas, a visitor centre and the starting point of the D 200 trail.

comeArrivare.nota: The Villa Madau staff is available to provide detailed directions and recommend certified nature guides.
